description: Every capability is exposed through proto + Connect-RPC. The CLI (`typescript-code-graph extract`, `typescript-code-graph rewrite plan`, `typescript-code-graph rewrite apply`) is a translation layer over Connect clients; the UI is the same. No REST/JSON workarounds.

requirements.description: Every capability exposed by typescript-code-graph must be available through all three surfaces with full parity: (1) Connect-RPC proto service definitions, (2) CLI commands (typescript-code-graph extract, typescript-code-graph rewrite plan, typescript-code-graph rewrite apply), and (3) UI. The CLI must be implemented as a thin translation layer over Connect-RPC clients — no business logic in the CLI layer. The UI must use the same Connect-RPC clients. REST/JSON workarounds, direct function calls bypassing Connect-RPC, and capability gaps between surfaces are prohibited.
requirements.title: Connect-RPC, CLI, and UI Capability Parity

validation.notes: Test that the CLI extract command constructs a valid ExtractRequest proto and delegates to the Connect client
Test that the CLI rewrite plan command constructs a valid RewriteRequest without plan_id and delegates to Connect client
Test that the CLI rewrite apply command requires --apply flag and constructs a RewriteRequest with plan_id
Test that CLI error output maps typed proto errors to human-readable stderr messages
TCG-CLI-RPC-PARITY: Run extract via CLI and via direct Connect-RPC call on the same fixture; assert identical graph output
TCG-UI-RPC-PARITY: UI extraction request produces the same graph as an equivalent CLI invocation
Verify no HTTP REST endpoints exist that bypass Connect-RPC; all routes are Connect-RPC handlers
CLI human-default output is stable across 10 consecutive runs on the same fixture (no timestamps or runtime-dependent output)
All documented capabilities are accessible from each of the three surfaces without workarounds
CLI --help output accurately describes all available commands and flags

title: Connect-RPC + CLI + UI Parity
